BG_009.name: Brassport Laundromat
BG_009.prompt: a retro city laundromat with a long row of round chrome-door tumble dryers, checkered black and white floor, plastic orange chairs, a big front window onto a brick street, pastel-teal walls

variants.DUSK: orange sunset light through the front window, fluorescent tubes flickering on

BG_010.name: Brassport Rooftops
BG_010.prompt: the brick rooftops of Brassport city with wooden water towers, chimney pots, clotheslines with flapping laundry, pigeons on ledges, the harbor and the open sea visible beyond

BG_011.name: Sock Island
BG_011.prompt: a small tropical island in a turquoise sea, white sand, leaning palm trees with long clotheslines strung between them where hundreds of single socks hang and rest like birds in a colony
